rows: Dutch stack process: lead + vinegar vapor + CO₂ from horse manure → surface carbonate crust
Why did oil painters prefer lead white for flesh?
Lower RI than TiO₂ → more transparency in oil → subtler gradations; also fast drying
Minium (red lead, Pb₃O₄) used in manuscript illumination → work done in minium = "miniatura"
Why does lead white darken in polluted air?
H₂S (pollution) + Pb²⁺ → PbS (black). Reversible with H₂O₂ treatment.
Transparency increase from lead soap formation reveals earlier layers/underdrawing
Why did titanium white replace lead white?
Non-toxic, 4× more opaque per unit, stable. Lead white banned in consumer paint (US 1978).
What is "Naples yellow hue" on paint tubes?
Non-toxic reformulation: cadmium yellow + white (or titanium yellow). Original = lead antimonate.
